gloss: to get angry, to be irritated

definitions.gloss: to get angry, to be irritated, to be annoyed
definitions.explanation: Describes a feeling of anger or irritation rising within oneself.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{態度|たいど}には{腹|はら}が{立|た}つ。
{約束|やくそく}を{破|やぶ}られて{腹|はら}が{立|た}った。
examples.english: I got angry when they broke their promise.

examples.japanese: {自分|じぶん}の{失敗|しっぱい}に{腹|はら}が{立|た}つ。
examples.english: I'm frustrated with my own mistake.

examples.japanese: {腹|はら}が{立|た}っても{顔|かお}に{出|だ}さない。
examples.english: Even when I'm angry, I don't show it on my face.

notes:
STRUCTURE: {腹|はら} (belly/stomach) + が + {立|た}つ (to stand/rise). Literally 'one's belly rises' - the belly being associated with emotions in Japanese.

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
- {怒|おこ}る (to get angry) - more direct, general term
- {頭|あたま}に{来|く}る (to get angry) - colloquial, 'it comes to one's head'
- {腹|はら}が{立|た}たしい (irritating) - adjective form
- {腹立|はらだ}ち (anger, irritation) - noun form

BODY PART METAPHOR: In Japanese, the {腹|はら} (belly) is considered the seat of emotions, similar to how English uses 'heart.' This explains expressions like {腹|はら}が{立|た}つ and {腹|はら}を{割|わ}って{話|はな}す (to speak frankly).

GRAMMAR: Often used with に to indicate the cause of anger: 〜に{腹|はら}が{立|た}つ
